# Support

## Getting Help

- **Documentation**: Start with [docs/](docs/) directory
- **FAQ**: Check existing [issues](https://github.com/aliasfoxkde/aegis/issues) for similar questions
- **Discussions**: Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/aliasfoxkde/aegis/discussions) for questions

## Ways to Contribute

### Report Bugs

- Search existing issues first
- Include reproduction steps
- Include version information (`aegis --version`)
- Include relevant code snippets and scan output

### Suggest Features

- Check existing issues and discussions
- Describe the use case and motivation
- Explain how it would help users

### Improve Documentation

- Fix typos and grammar
- Add examples
- Translate to other languages
- Improve existing guides

### Add Patterns

- Check existing patterns first
- Follow the [YAML pattern format](docs/guides/ADDING_PATTERNS.md)
- Include test cases
- Submit via pull request

## Community Guidelines

- Be respectful and inclusive
- Follow [GitHub Community Guidelines](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-code-of-conduct)
- Be patient with responses

## Emergency Issues

For critical security vulnerabilities, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
